HowItWorksPage.title: How it works
HowItWorksPage.intro: Booking with Veroya is simple and personal. Here is the process, from your request to your arrival.
HowItWorksPage.s1Text: Explore our cities and choose the apartment that fits your dates, number of guests and needs.
HowItWorksPage.s2Text: Fill in the form with your details and dates. Once sent, you'll see your booking code and a PIN: keep them for any enquiry.
HowItWorksPage.s3Text: Our team checks availability and gets in touch to confirm your booking and explain the next steps.
HowItWorksPage.s4Text: Before you arrive we send you the access instructions. During your stay, we're available for anything you need.
HowItWorksPage.ctaText: Discover the apartments available in each city.

LongStaysPage.title: Long stays
LongStaysPage.intro: Coming to work, study or live here for a while? We have apartments ready for stays of one or several months.
LongStaysPage.s1Text: Equipped kitchen, washing machine, good Wi-Fi and, in many apartments, a comfortable space to work.
LongStaysPage.s2Text: Long stays come with special terms. Tell us your dates and we'll prepare a proposal.
LongStaysPage.s3Text: A friendly team to handle issues, maintenance and any questions while you live in the apartment.
LongStaysPage.s4Text: We adjust check-in and check-out dates where possible to fit your plans.
LongStaysPage.ctaText: Look for apartments marked «Long stay» in each city.

OwnersPage.title: Owners
OwnersPage.intro: Do you own an apartment in one of our cities? We manage it for you so you earn income without the hassle.
OwnersPage.s1Text: Listing, guest communication, check-ins and check-outs, cleaning and maintenance.
OwnersPage.s2Text: We review every request and keep in touch with guests before and during their stay.
OwnersPage.s3Text: Clear, regular information about your property's bookings and income.
OwnersPage.s4Text: We combine different types of stay to make the most of your apartment all year round.
OwnersPage.ctaText: Write to us and we'll tell you how we can help. [Contact details pending]
